key_insight: The paper defines a minimal exact memory state for partially observable control by using a stable quotient, where the current observation plus quotient class is sufficient to restore Markovian dynamics.
engineering_relevance: This gives a principled way to compress POMDP state for reinforcement learning and control systems, enabling smaller memory controllers without sacrificing optimality when the assumptions hold.
method: Construct a stable quotient: the coarsest observation-wise abstraction that preserves one-step rewards and successor structure.
Use the pair of current observation and stable class as an exact finite Markov state.
Track classes via ordered edge transports and, when diagnostics exist, infer local coordinates with nearest-prototype recovery and calibrate-then-restart learning.
evidence_signal: Experiments report exact compression from raw states to quotient states and perfect paired-order accuracy with three decision-time memory states, matching the quotient oracle and outperforming non-oracle baselines.
watch_item: The guarantees rely on a structured holonomy-cover process and correct initialization/diagnostic assumptions, so performance may degrade when these conditions do not hold.
paper_title: Minimal Markovization via Stable Quotients in Holonomy-Cover Decision Processes
